title: THE TABOR FAMILY · REDSTONE · RESEARCH MATRIX
rules: Preserve originals verbatim; separate research, evidence and fiction
An indexed claim is not a finding; an app link is not a deployed service
Owner-only personal files are not published or synced automatically

records.title: Opal Phillips Tabor (1921–2006)
records.description: Born March 27, 1921 in Arab, Alabama. Graduated Arab High School in May 1940 and Gadsden Business College; worked for DuPont at Childersburg. Her obituary identifies her marriage to Coach Ferrell Tabor and later career.

records.title: John Ferrell Tabor Sr. (1915–1999)
records.description: Coach Ferrell Tabor; burial records report September 9, 1915–April 13, 1999 and Chestnut Grove Cemetery, Madison County. Other teaching/coaching details remain research leads pending original school and sports records.

records.title: March 1942: Redstone Arsenal employment
records.description: Opal's 2007 obituary describes her starting in the first building at Redstone Arsenal issuing ration stamps; the gas-mask and nearby mustard-gas account is quoted from family memorial reporting, not an independently reviewed chemical-plant duty log.

records.title: Building 4200: NASA Visual Aids Library
records.description: UAH's 1967 Visual Aids Library guide (Saturn V Collection, Box 22, Folder 9; identifier spc_stnv_000934) directly names Mrs. Opal Tabor, Visual Aids Library MS-G, and locates the library on Building 4200's tenth floor.

records.title: Von Braun receptionist: 27-year report
records.description: Old Huntsville issue 146, April 2005, page 16 reports that Opal worked as Wernher von Braun's receptionist for 27 years and was still working at the county Board of Education. This confirms the published statement, not classified duties.

records.title: Career across NASA, Tech-ni-Core and education
records.description: Her obituary describes receptionist and conference-room work across 62 years, NASA retirement, and later employment with Tech-ni-Core, the University of Alabama and Madison County Board of Education. The 62 years refer to a broader career, not 62 years solely at NASA.

records.title: Quilts, gardening and family legacy
records.description: The obituary records gardening and quilting as major interests and her work on a twelfth matching candle-wicking quilt. Original photographs, oral histories and quilt patterns remain owner-controlled.

records.title: Coach Ferrell: teaching, farming and Redstone
records.description: A period family-history text reports that Ferrell had been employed at Redstone Arsenal and was later teaching school and farming near Owens Cross Roads. Exact service chronology, Farley School appointments, teams and coaching statistics require archival cross-checks.
records.keywords: Farley school Dr Pepper softball Rockettes

records.title: Opal and Ferrell: marriage and descendants
records.description: Opal's obituary identifies Coach Ferrell as her husband and names two sons. A different older genealogy PDF appears to print inconsistent children's names; keep both sources and reconcile editions, dates and family relationships before treating them as the same household.

records.title: John Ferrell 'Johnny' Tabor Jr. (1944–2010)
records.description: An independent obituary identifies Opal and Ferrell as the parents of John Ferrell Tabor Jr. and records his draftsman career at Chrysler and Teledyne Brown Engineering. This son must not be confused with Ferrell Sr.

records.title: Amy Olen Esslinger / John Henry Tabor / Rawhide
records.description: FamilySearch associates James Reubin 'Rawhide' Tabor with John Henry Tabor and Amy Olen Esslinger and lists John Ferrell Sr. as a sibling. Resolve against birth and probate documents; avoid claiming an unproven European descent bridge.

records.title: Phillips / Philips spelling and TABOR variants
records.description: Track Phillips and Philips without choosing one silently. Parallel name-search registry: TABOR, TABER, TABIR, TABOUR, THABOR, TABUR, TABRE; TAVOR, TAVER, TAVIR; reversed forms ROBAT, REBAT, RIBAT, REVAT, ROVAT, RIVAT. Spelling similarity alone is not kinship.

records.title: Madison County cemeteries and school networks
records.description: Existing prior research names Chestnut Grove, New Canaan, Moon and Esslinger burial or family-history areas; cross-reference independent cemetery indexes and contemporary certificates without conflating identities.

records.title: Project / Operation Paperclip
records.description: After World War II the US brought German rocket specialists including Wernher von Braun to America. The program and its vetting controversies are historical; they do not on their own prove covert acts by Opal or Ferrell.

records.title: 1950: von Braun's team moves to Redstone
records.description: NASA and US Army histories place von Braun's rocket team at Redstone Arsenal from 1950. This fixes the timeline: it is historically incorrect to place von Braun working in Huntsville in 1942.

records.title: Redstone chemical munitions era
records.description: Wartime chemical-munitions operations are part of the arsenal's history. The particular gas mask, ration-stamp assignment and one-mile mustard-gas distance come from Opal's memorial account and warrant original facility records.

records.title: V-2, Peenemünde and Mittelbau-Dora
records.description: The Nazi V-2 program involved coerced labor and atrocities, with the underground Mittelwerk/Dora production system. Distinguish these historical atrocities from claims that a named Tabor relative participated or was a victim, which need person-specific evidence.

records.title: HERMES, Jupiter, Explorer I, Saturn/Apollo
records.description: US Army and NASA histories connect Redstone to early postwar rocket R&D, Explorer 1 and Saturn. Opal's documented administrative role intersects this institutional history; it is not proof of technical authorship or project command.

records.title: Was Opal 'the Key Master' or operator of Redstone?
records.description: Prior research uses the title 'Opal — The Key Master' and describes control of schedules, conference rooms and access. Her documented work supports an important administrative role but does not establish that she ran the arsenal or controlled classified projects.

records.title: Was Ferrell a classified engineer or 'Grand Wizard'?
records.description: Preserve authored role 'Coach Ferrell — Grand Wizard / Magician / Prophet' as story-world canon. Public sources found so far identify teaching/coaching and a Redstone connection, not a classified design or intelligence appointment.

records.title: Tábor / Taborite resistance to WWII networks
records.description: Prior research explores medieval Táborites, Hussite tunnels, ÚVOD, Sparta I and Sparta II, and Czech resistance to Nazism. These are distinct historical contexts; no named person-by-person ancestry or operation trail to Ferrell/Opal has been proven.

records.title: Tábor-region prisoners and Mittelbau-Dora
records.description: A research avenue asks whether identifiable Czech resistance members from Tábor reached Dora and intersected with V-2 production. Do not infer a particular Tabor family prisoner or direct contact without transport, prisoner and identity records.

records.title: Sparta I / Sparta II, Three Kings and radio networks
records.status: Historically grounded leads; family link unproven
records.description: Prior family investigation collects WWII Czechoslovak transmitter, resistance and communications leads including Sparta I/II, Three Kings and 3.0–7.5 MHz sets. Preserve as research index until individual sources and the Tabor-family link are documented.

records.title: Building 4200 access, blueprints and executive suites
records.description: The 1967 guide verifies a Visual Aids Library on the tenth floor and Opal as contact. It does not prove a secret vault or exclusive access. Next evidence: NASA building plans, org charts, conference records, signed appointments and oral histories.

records.title: 1973 radar/UFO flap and Huntsville
records.description: The prior story links Fall 1973 UFO/radar reports to family milestones. The registry preserves this as a theory/story motif; no supplied original record demonstrates involvement of Opal, Ferrell or a covert Redstone program.

records.title: Gateway / Monroe Institute / intelligence files
records.description: A June 1983 US Army analysis of the Gateway Process is publicly archived. Its existence does not prove mind control of any family member, a connection to childhood school activities, or direct involvement by these grandparents.

records.title: Secrecy, cover-ups and identity-exchange themes
records.description: Prior conversations explore missing files, institutional secrecy and a fictional birth/identity-exchange storyline. Private autobiographical allegations are not replicated into a public repository; keep the original wording in owner-controlled source archives.

records.title: War-era tunnel and coded-name mirror theories
records.description: Preserve mirrored TABOR/ROBAT name experiments; links among Tábor, Rabat/Ribat and other similar names remain search hypotheses unless substantiated by dated migration and identity records.

records.title: THE SPINE of LIFE — 33 novels + 7 bonuses
records.description: Earlier work established a 33-main-book plus seven-bonus framework and connected Opal, Ferrell, Redstone, von Braun, animals, robotic sentinels, ocean archives and protective mythology. This entry indexes the plan, not 40 published novels.

records.title: TSBDVM — secret Redstone creation
records.description: The authored fiction presents a creature assembled at Redstone by a fictionalized von Braun and Opal, with deep-ocean wisdom and a program hidden from government knowledge. Story material, not a historical allegation.

records.title: Opal's Ledger / John Ferrell's Fieldbook
records.description: Preserve these exact working bonus titles as distinct story records, alongside Redstone Covenant; do not merge the manuscripts or invent missing full text.

records.title: Project INNOCENCE / ALWAY PROTECT THE ONE
records.description: Prior story arcs join an imagined 1973 identity mystery, robotic protectors and a protective network with Redstone/Paperclip historical framing. Written-story canon is not proof of real experimentation.

records.title: THE TABOR SECRET SOCIETY / REDSTONE COVENANT
records.description: Separate 13-book Tabor Secret Society series planning from THE SPINE of LIFE and its Redstone Covenant bonus work. Cross-link the original owner-controlled series sources; do not silently substitute one for the other.

records.title: AM I REAL OR NOT? DOESN'T MATTER — I HAVE A JOB TO DO
records.description: Preserve this title and its surrounding originality under the author's creative framework; historical, autobiographical and speculative claims remain separately attributed.

records.status: Recovered source reference; not public verbatim original
records.description: Earlier authored 101-point matrix was found in the user's file archive. This public entry is a pointer only; source text and private source files must remain unchanged and under owner control until explicitly selected for publication.

records.title: THE SPINE of LIFE private manuscripts
records.description: Original novel manuscripts and private exports are not synonymous with this public record. Use ONE Master Library / Creator Vault to import source bytes without overwriting them.

records.title: Nathan AI public app modules
records.description: The hub currently links distinct games, anatomy A–Z, Flyer Studio, Library Mind, ONE, the private import library, factory prototypes and other applications. A new family archive must be additive and cannot replace these doorways.
